page.title: Payment Settlements

page.noPump: Select a pump to view settlement records.

wallet.totalInTransit: Total amount still in transit — not yet credited to your bank account

wallet.label: Money in transit by payment type

pendingByAge.title: Waiting for the bank
pendingByAge.note: Unsettled collections by collection date. Card and UPI money is due within 2 days (T+2).

history.emptyTitle: No activity in this date range
history.emptySubtitle: No shift collections or settlements were found between the selected dates.

alerts.intro: Set the time when you want to receive a daily reminder to record each payment type's settlement. Alerts arrive as in-app notifications — once per day, after the configured time.

record.subtitle: Enter the amount credited to your bank account
record.amountPositive: Amount must be greater than zero
record.amountTooHigh: Amount is more than the {{pending}} still pending for {{type}}
record.title: Record settlement
record.bankReferenceHelp: A reference already recorded for this pump is refused, so the same credit is not counted twice.

void.title: Void settlement
void.explanation: The settlement stays on record but no longer counts as received, so the pending balance goes back up.
